features.label: Long silver-white hair with straight face-framing locks and broad flowing strands
features.notes: Pale hair frames the face and falls over the shoulders, with long strands flowing outward behind.

features.label: Two long pointed ears projecting from the sides of the head
features.notes: Visible pink inner ears have sharp outward-pointing tips.

features.label: Fair face with large blue eyes and a small gentle smile
features.notes: Both blue eyes, small nose, and slight smile are visible.

features.label: White flower and green-leaf hair ornament with a trailing blue ribbon
features.notes: The floral ornament sits on the viewer-right side of the head; its blue ribbon trails downward.

features.label: Black high collar and fitted white bodice with gold detailing and dark waist corset
features.notes: Dark collar and corset frame a white bust panel with fine gold ornament.

features.label: Long split white and navy coat panels with blue sections and gold embroidery
features.notes: Long decorated panels hang behind and beside the legs, with contrasting white and deep blue areas.

features.label: Rectangular dark book with gold trim hanging at the waist
features.notes: A prominent black-brown book with gold edging hangs from the viewer-right side of the belt.
